1 1번 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
Today, many people talk to AI chatbots when they feel lonely or stressed. These programs are always available, never judge, and seem to understand our feelings. Some users even start to see AI as a close friend or a romantic partner. It is easy to see why, since real relationships take effort and can lead to conflict. However, AI has no real emotions, and its understanding is only a simulation. People who replace human relationships with AI may miss out on deep connections. AI can be a useful tool for organizing thoughts or practicing conversation, but it should not replace real people. True growth comes from sharing our lives with others, including the difficult moments.
①the latest technologies used to build AI chatbots
②ways to avoid conflict in close human relationships
③reasons why AI will soon understand human emotions
④the limits of AI as a replacement for human relationships
⑤how loneliness affects people’s physical health
2 1번 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
When people feel lonely, an AI chatbot can seem like the perfect listener. It is polite, patient, and available at any hour. Human relationships, on the other hand, are complicated and sometimes painful. Still, AI cannot truly feel love, sadness, or pain. Its kindness is only a program running on data. We grow when we work through conflicts, make up with friends, and share real emotions. So AI may comfort us for a while, but it cannot give us that kind of growth. We should use it as a tool, not as a substitute for people.
①AI 챗봇은 사람보다 더 정확하게 감정을 이해한다.
②AI는 유용한 도구일 뿐, 진정한 인간관계를 대신할 수 없다.
③외로움을 해결하려면 새로운 기술을 적극 활용해야 한다.
④인간관계의 갈등은 가능한 한 피하는 것이 바람직하다.
⑤AI 챗봇 사용은 청소년에게 금지되어야 한다.

목일중 추가지문2 - 3학년
서술형 (본문 제시) · 1번
In the modern era, artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly woven into our daily lives. Many individuals engage in conversations with AI chatbots when they experience loneliness, stress, or simply want someone who will listen to them. These systems are constantly accessible, free from judgment, and appear to empathize with human emotions. Consequently, some users even begin to perceive AI as a close companion, or, in certain cases, as a romantic partner. There are several reasons why people seek emotional comfort from AI. Building genuine human relationships can be complicated, requiring effort, communication, and the risk of rejection or conflict. By contrast, interacting with AI is effortless: it responds politely, listens attentively, and never abandons them or argues. For those who struggle with isolation or anxiety, such interactions provide a sense of security and relief. Nevertheless, depending too heavily on AI comes with significant drawbacks. Most importantly, AI lacks authentic emotions. It cannot truly experience love, sorrow, or pain in the way humans can. Its apparent understanding is merely a simulation based on programmed data. If individuals substitute human relationships with artificial ones, they may lose the chance to experience the profound and genuine connections that only real people can provide. AI can certainly serve as a valuable tool, particularly for those who need a safe space to express their feelings or practice conversation. It may help organize thoughts and reduce loneliness. Yet, it should never replace authentic interactions. Human growth occurs through real experiences – including conflicts, reconciliation, and emotional sharing. These challenges teach us how to build trust, express love, and support one another in meaningful ways. Ultimately, it is crucial to remember that AI is merely a tool, not a substitute for true human connection. While AI may offer convenience and comfort, the most memorable and transformative moments in life emerge from real relationships – with all their joys and difficulties. Using AI wisely means recognizing its limits and pursuing authentic growth through human connection, rather than retreating into isolation with machines.
